title: The jobs apocalypse is postponed. An AI jobs boom is here
summary: The Economist article reports that contrary to widespread fears of AI-driven unemployment, a jobs boom linked to AI is currently underway. The anticipated 'jobs apocalypse' has been postponed as artificial intelligence creates new economic opportunities and employment rather than destroying existing jobs at the scale originally feared.
problem_solved: Challenges the prevailing narrative that AI would cause massive, widespread job displacement across industries.
why_valuable: Provides evidence-based economic analysis that counters AI pessimism with real-world employment data, helping policymakers and businesses make informed decisions about AI adoption.
